role: Pure scoring for the 15%-weight Vitals factor of the recovery composite: resting/sleep-HR, respiratory-rate and wrist-temperature sub-scores, the breakdown's Vitals row and its localized line, the frozen-breakdown RR refresh, and the post-composite SpO2 penalty. Reached in production through RecoveryScoreCalculator+VitalsForwarding and ScoreDetailBuilder.buildTier3.
types: VitalsScoring: enum — static-only namespace for vitals sub-scores and their display text

flags.text: calculateVitalsScore/describeVitals treat RecoveryVitals.wristTemperature as a personal deviation ('arrives as a deviation already'), but the model documents that field as an offset from a fixed 36.5 C, NOT a personal deviation; correctness depends on every caller first applying RecoveryScoreCalculator.wristTemperatureAgainstPersonalBaseline (computeBreakdown and refreshedVitalsFactor do; tests call calculateVitalsScore directly with raw values).

API_REFERENCE describes this file as 'Penalty-only vitals overrides (respiratory rate, wrist temperature, SpO2)' declared as 'extension RecoveryScoreCalculator' taking HealthKitManager.RecoveryVitals and 'also contains calculate() overloads, label(for:), message(for:), toTenScale'; the file is enum VitalsScoring taking top-level RecoveryVitals, scores RR/temp/RHR as the 15% factor, and its header says the calculate entry points and display helpers stayed in RecoveryScoreCalculator.

units.does: Averages the available vitals sub-scores (sleep/resting HR vs personal baseline, respiratory rate vs 7-day baseline or population window, wrist-temperature deviation step score) into a 0-100 score; returns nil when vitals is nil or no sub-score is computable (SpO2 alone yields nil).

branches.effect: return nil (caller falls back to Tier 2); else continue

branches.cond: restingHRSubScore returned a value (RHR + baseline mean>0 + SD>0)
branches.effect: append RHR sub-score; else RHR dropped from the average
append RR sub-score; else dropped
append temperatureSubScore(value) treating it as a deviation; else dropped
return nil; else return arithmetic mean of the sub-scores

flags.text: Doc says RR scores 100 'within ±band of baseline' with a penalty 'per br/min above baseline'; respiratorySubScore only penalizes the excess above baseline+band (dev-1.0) and gives 100 to any amount below baseline, so the penalty is per br/min above the band edge, not above baseline.

units.does: Sleep/resting-HR sub-score: 100 minus rhrPenaltyPerSD (10) per SD the HR sits above meanHRBaseline, floored at 0 and never above 100 (below-baseline clamps to 0 excess). Nil without HR, baseline>0 and SD>0.

branches.cond: restingHeartRate, meanHRBaseline>0 and meanHRSD>0 all present
branches.effect: compute max(0, 100 - max(0,(rhr-baseline)/sd)*10); otherwise return nil (sub-score dropped)

units.does: Respiratory sub-score: with a 7-day baseline, 100 minus 15 points per br/min above baseline+1.0 (floor 0); without a baseline but with a rate, the population-window score; nil with no rate.

branches.cond: vitals.respiratoryDeviation non-nil (rate and baseline both present)
branches.effect: return max(0, 100 - max(0, dev-1.0)*15); else fall through
return nil; else return respiratoryPopulationScore(rate)

units.does: Builds the breakdown's 'Vitals' ScoreFactor: detail text and facts from describeVitals, the given score and weight, and impact positive (>=80) / neutral (>=60) / negative.

branches.effect: impact .positive when >=80, .neutral when 60..<80, .negative below 60

units.does: Returns only the text of describeVitals (the Vitals line in NarrativeLanguage, temperature in Celsius).

flags.text: No production caller: its only callers are the RecoveryScoreCalculator.buildVitalsDetail forwarder (itself called only from ScoringCharacterizationTests:569) and ScoreFactorFactsTests:72. Production builds the line through vitalsFactor/describeVitals.

units.does: Produces the Vitals detail: a .noVitals note when vitals is nil, otherwise facts from vitalsFacts and the text vitalsLine(facts, .celsius), packaged as a DescribedDetail with ScoreFactorFacts(vitals:).

branches.effect: return DescribedDetail.note(.noVitals); else build facts + line

units.does: Collects each vitals input with the sub-score that scored it into ScoreFactorFacts.Vitals (average = given score): sleep HR, delta vs baseline and score; RR deviation/rate/score; temperature deviation and score.

branches.cond: restingHeartRate, meanHRBaseline and a non-nil restingHRSubScore all present
branches.effect: set sleepHRDelta = HR - baseline and sleepHRScore; else both stay nil, so the line reads '(no baseline yet)'

flags.text: When meanHRBaseline exists but meanHRSD is nil or 0, restingHRSubScore returns nil, so sleepHRDelta stays nil and sleepHRClause tells the user 'Sleep HR N (no baseline yet)' although a baseline exists.

units.does: Joins the sleep-HR, respiratory and temperature clauses plus 'avg N' (rounded average) with ' · ' into the localized Vitals line; temperature in the requested unit.
Formats the Sleep HR clause: 'no data', 'N (no baseline yet)', 'N at baseline → score' when |delta|<1, else 'N (±d bpm) → score'.

branches.effect: return 'Sleep HR — no data'; else continue
return 'Sleep HR N (no baseline yet)'; else continue
return 'Sleep HR N at baseline → score'; else return with signed delta in bpm

units.does: Formats the RR clause: 'RR — no data' without a sub-score; 'RR ±d br/min → score' with a baseline deviation; 'RR r br/min (vs pop) → score' for the population fallback.

branches.effect: return rrNoData; else continue
return deviation form; else continue
return rrNoData (unreachable in practice when a score exists, since a score needs a rate); else return '(vs pop)' form

units.does: Formats the temperature clause: 'Temp — no data' or 'Temp ±d°unit → score', converting the Celsius deviation via TemperatureUnit.convert (×9/5 for F) and using the stored sub-score or recomputing it.

branches.effect: return 'Temp — no data'; else format
fallback recomputes temperatureSubScore(deviation); used for facts stored without a score

units.does: Asymmetric step score on the positive temperature deviation: <=0.3°C → 100, <=0.5 → temperatureScoreMild, <=1.0 → temperatureScoreModerate, else temperatureScoreSevere; negative deviations clamp to 0 → 100.

branches.effect: return 100
return temperatureScoreMild
return temperatureScoreModerate; else return temperatureScoreSevere

units.does: Returns the frozen breakdown unchanged unless freshVitals carries a respiratory rate and a 'Vitals' factor reports no respiration; then replaces that factor (detail + sub-score) with one rebuilt from freshVitals while keeping composite, tier, penalties, spo2 flag and scoringVersion.

branches.cond: freshVitals nil or its respiratoryRate nil
branches.effect: return breakdown unchanged
replace with refreshedVitalsFactor and mark changed; else keep the factor
return original breakdown; else return a new ScoreBreakdown with refreshed factors

flags.text: The refreshed Vitals factor score changes while compositeScore stays frozen, so the breakdown's weighted factor contributions no longer sum to the headline score the user sees on the same screen.

units.does: Localized 'RR — no data' string in NarrativeLanguage.

Decides whether a frozen Vitals factor lacked respiration: from facts.vitals.respiratoryScore == nil when facts exist, else by matching the stored detail text against English 'RR — no data' or the current-language rrNoData.

branches.effect: return respiratoryScore == nil; else fall back to text matching (a line stored in a third language that is neither English nor the current language is not detected)

units.does: Rebuilds the Vitals factor from fresh vitals: re-expresses wrist temperature against the personal baseline, rescores (falling back to the old score if nil) and builds a new vitalsFactor keeping the old weight.

branches.effect: use factor.score; unreachable from breakdownRefreshingVitalsFactor because it requires a respiratory rate, which always yields an RR sub-score

units.does: Population-norm RR score: 100 inside [12,18] br/min, 100 - 15 per br/min above 18 (floor 0), flat 90 below 12.

branches.effect: return 100
return max(0, 100 - (rate-popMax)*15); else (below popMin) return respiratoryRateBelowPopulationScore (90)

units.does: Applies the post-composite SpO2 penalty: subtracts RecoveryScoreConstants.Vitals.spo2Penalty when SpO2 < 95%, floored at 0; returns score unchanged for nil vitals.

branches.effect: return score unchanged
subtract spo2Penalty; else no change; result floored at 0
return the one penalty string; else []
